[EN] Have you ever built a house? Tons of work! Really worth it, though. I'd say it's very fulfilling.

It's nice to see people safe and warm inside something that you built.
[ES] ¿Alguna vez has construido una casa? ¡Muchísimo trabajo! Aunque realmente vale la pena. Diría que es muy gratificante.

Es bueno ver a la gente segura y abrigada dentro de algo que tú construiste.
